title: Exodus 3:2 — God in thorns: judgment and mercy in the burning bush
summary: Exodus 3:2 (the burning bush) under the heading GOD IN THORNS, with the word bush highlighted in green each time it appears. A red-underlined comment at the bottom reads: Judgment, the bush was burning with fire; Mercy, yet the bush was not consumed.

text.text: 2 The angel of the LORD appeared to him in a blazing fire from the midst of a bush; and he looked, and behold, the bush was burning with fire, yet the bush was not consumed.
Judgment—the bush was burning with fire,
Mercy—yet the bush was not consumed.

uncertain: Moses is not named on the slide; 'him' refers to him in context. In the heading GOD the letters G, O, D are in different colours; only the L and R of LORD are coloured in the verse (meaning not stated).
